WITH cur AS (
), enriched AS ( SELECT c.warehouse_id, c.item_id, c.batch_id, c.qty, COALESCE(b.production_date, (SELECT MIN(t2.created_at)::date FROM stock_transaction t2 WHERE t2.warehouse_id = c.warehouse_id AND t2.item_id = c.item_id AND t2.biz_code IN ('inbound', 'transfer_in', 'adjust_in') AND t2.batch_id = 0)) AS prod_date FROM cur c LEFT JOIN batch b ON b.id = c.batch_id AND c.batch_id <> 0 )

SELECT e.warehouse_id AS "warehouseId", e.item_id AS "itemId", e.batch_id AS "batchId", b2.batch_no AS "batchNo", e.prod_date AS "prodDate", (CURRENT_DATE - e.prod_date) AS "ageDays", e.qty AS "qty", NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_transaction t3 WHERE t3.warehouse_id = e.warehouse_id AND t3.item_id = e.item_id AND t3.biz_code IN ('outbound', 'transfer_out', 'adjust_out') AND t3.created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(days => #{q.stagnantDays})) AS "stagnant" FROM enriched e LEFT JOIN batch b2 ON b2.id = e.batch_id AND e.batch_id <> 0
ORDER BY e.warehouse_id, e.item_id, e.batch_id LIMIT #{q.limit} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT b.supplier_id AS "partyId", COALESCE(p.order_count, 0) AS "orderCount", COALESCE(p.order_qty, 0) AS "orderQty", COALESCE(p.order_amount, 0) AS "orderAmount", COALESCE(r.return_qty, 0) AS "returnQty", COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS "returnAmount" FROM base b LEFT JOIN po p ON p.supplier_id = b.supplier_id LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.supplier_id = b.supplier_id ORDER BY b.supplier_id LIMIT #{q.limit} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT b.customer_id AS "partyId", COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS "orderCount", COALESCE(s.order_qty, 0) AS "orderQty", COALESCE(s.order_amount, 0) AS "orderAmount", COALESCE(r.return_qty, 0) AS "returnQty", COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS "returnAmount" FROM base b LEFT JOIN so s ON s.customer_id = b.customer_id LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.customer_id = b.customer_id ORDER BY b.customer_id LIMIT #{q.limit} OFFSET #{q.offset}
